# Status: __APP__

The per-app checklist from the prototype-to-spec process. Each command updates its item, links its output and adds a changelog line.

**Next:** `/pre.prototype-new <name> <your idea and first features>`

## Phases

- [x] 0. App folder set up (__DATE__)
- [ ] 1. Discovery (prototypes below; go back here any time until the middle-steps document is frozen)
- [ ] 2. Combined requirements and needs reviewed: [requirements](requirements.md), [needs](needs.md)
- [ ] 2. Risks reviewed: [risks](middle/risks.md)
- [ ] 2. Feasibility reviewed; reductions confirmed: [feasibility](middle/feasibility.md)
- [ ] 2. Quality attributes reviewed: [quality](middle/quality.md)
- [ ] 2. Constraints reviewed: [constraints](middle/constraints.md)
- [ ] 2. Threat model (STRIDE) reviewed: [threats](middle/threats.md)
- [ ] 2. Scope reviewed: [scope](middle/scope.md)
- [ ] 2. `/pre.ready` finds nothing missing (open: undecided implicit requirements, listed in [requirements](requirements.md))
- [ ] 2. Middle-steps document frozen; user goals confirmed; constitution drafted: [document](middle-steps.md), [constitution draft](constitution-draft.md)
- [ ] 3. Git started; Spec Kit initialised; constitution set
